source_cards_add.title: Improving Inference-Time Optimisation for Vocal Effects Style Transfer with a Gaussian Prior
source_cards_add.evidence_scope: single-vocal style transfer through fixed 130-parameter DiffVox topology

knowledge_cards_add.claim: A misspecified full-covariance Gaussian can regularize search without faithfully modelling the non-Gaussian preset distribution.
Prior strength is encoder- and protocol-specific, not a transferable mixing default.
PMSE against an inverse-fit oracle cannot substitute for audio metrics and listening because effect parameters are non-identifiable.
The 16-listener result is directional and inconclusive; AFx-Rep versus regression was not significant at p=.117.
An unconditional centre-seeking prior requires an explicit outlier/rare-style gate.

rules_update.name: vocal_fx_coupled_search_shadow_only
rules_update.applies_when: project-owned vocal; fixed renderer and parameterization match prior; stable baseline; declared section/role; shadow only
rules_update.change: test one frozen empirical prior term off/on while holding renderer, encoder, initialization, seeds, budget and automation fixed
rules_update.verify: unmatched raw measurement renders plus separate BS.1770-matched blind copies; report centre and outlier strata separately
rules_update.cancel: level-only benefit, inconsistent preference, protected regression, or outlier shrinkage

experiments_add.material: project-owned Logoped - Pena dry lead-vocal phrases with frozen synthetic in-topology references
experiments_add.factor: empirical prior term off versus one predeclared non-zero weight
experiments_add.variant_B: same search with fixed non-zero prior weight
experiments_add.loudness_match: separate section-wise BS.1770-matched true-peak-safe blinded copies; raw renders preserved
experiments_add.success: B improves at least two audio-domain metrics and is selected at least 2 of 3 for centre case without protected regression or material outlier loss
experiments_add.cancel: level-only benefit, worse perceived role despite vector gain, outlier collapse, instability/NaN/peak/mono regression, or inconsistent preference
